title: Version comparison
task: Implement compare_versions(a, b) in versions.py for dotted numeric versions such as '1.2.10': return -1, 0 or 1. Missing trailing parts count as 0 ('1.2' equals '1.2.0'). Raise ValueError for anything else. Add tests.
follow_up: Requirement change: a version may carry a pre-release suffix after a '-', as in '1.2.0-rc1' or '2.0.0-beta'. A pre-release sorts before the same version without one; two pre-releases of the same version compare by their suffixes, split into alphabetic and numeric parts, the numbers compared numerically ('rc2' < 'rc10', 'alpha' < 'beta'). Add tests.
